title: My Hobby
description: Practise like + -ing and can, and write a short message about your hobby.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: After like, use the -ing form: I like drawing.

exercises.prompt: Write one word to complete the question.
exercises.text: ___ your brother like music? Yes, he does.
answers: Does
exercises.explanation: Make present simple questions with he, she or it using Does + subject + base verb: Does your brother like ...?

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I play football with my friends on Saturdays.
On Saturdays I play football with my friends.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + object + who with + time: I play football with my friends on Saturdays.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: She can plays the piano very well.
answers: She can play the piano very well.
exercises.explanation: After can, use the base verb with no -s: she can play.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I ___ play chess, but I can't play tennis.
exercises.explanation: "But" shows the two ideas are opposite, so the first one is positive: I can play chess, but I can't play tennis.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: My hobby is reading comics.
My hobby's reading comics.
My hobbies are reading comics.
exercises.explanation: One hobby is singular, so use "is": my hobby is.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "have got" with I, you, we and they: I have got.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
answers: plays
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, add -s to the verb: she plays.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I love swim in the sea.
answers: I love swimming in the sea.
I love to swim in the sea.
exercises.explanation: After love and like, use verb-ing (or to + verb): I love swimming.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My brother can run very fast.
Can my brother run very fast?
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + verb: My brother can run very fast.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I go to dance class ___ Tuesday.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Tuesday.

exercises.prompt: Write a or an.
exercises.text: I like taking photos. I have got ___ old camera.
answers: an
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an old camera.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Do you like reading ___ watching TV?
exercises.explanation: Use "or" in questions to give a choice.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Jack plays football with he friends.
answers: Jack plays football with his friends.
exercises.explanation: Use "his" (not "he") before a noun to show that something belongs to a boy or man.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My dad doesn't like dancing.
exercises.explanation: Subject + doesn't like + verb-ing: My dad doesn't like dancing.

exercises.prompt: Write the plural of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: I have got three ___ (box) of old comics.
answers: boxes
exercises.explanation: Nouns ending in -x take -es in the plural: boxes.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There ___ a chess club at my school.
exercises.explanation: Use "there is" with one thing: there is a chess club.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My friends is in the drama club.
answers: My friends are in the drama club.
My friend is in the drama club.
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with plural nouns (my friends) and "is" with one person (my friend).

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I play my guitar in my room.
In my room I play my guitar.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" for a room: in my room.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question.
answers: Can
exercises.explanation: Ask about ability with "Can" + subject + verb: Can you swim?

task.prompt: You are in a new English club. Write a message to the club about your hobby.
contentPoints: Say your name and your hobby.
Say when and where you do it.
Ask the club members a question.
usefulLanguage: My name is ... and my hobby is ...
I ... every day / at the weekend.
task.modelAnswer:
Hello everyone,

My name is Nam and my hobby is drawing. I draw every day after school in my bedroom. I like drawing animals and cartoons. I like it because it is fun and relaxing. Can you draw too?

Nam
